S06/run_0_a_front_pushed.summary: Three recorders; both chain contacts named A-B and B-C at the right instants; no anonymous road user, no overlap, no jump.

S06/run_0_b_rear_first.summary: B-C first, then A-B, both named correctly (the case lost by the lower-bound-only rule during development); bodies stay apart.

S10/run_0_rolls_through.summary: The S10 regression is gone: A rolling through the stop is named as B's partner at the contact; no spurious road user.

S17/run_0_crash.summary: Collision A-B and the unobserved cut-in U1 are correct up to +0.5 s; the automatic flag reports a second anonymous body overlapping U1 from +1.75 s (post-impact duplicate, after the analysed window).

findings.problem: U1 / U2 drawn bodies overlap (likely one car split after the crash)

S18/run_0_abreast.summary: Collision A-B correct; anonymous U1 box jumps 3.7 m at -1.1 s (re-assignment between two abreast cars or a late merge).

S18/run_0_passing.summary: Collision A-B correct; after the contact two anonymous bodies (U1 / U3) overlap: an unmerged cross-recorder duplicate.

findings.problem: U1 / U3 overlap after the collision

S18/run_0_platoon.summary: Collision A-B correct; after the contact U3 (seen by B) and U4 (seen by A) are drawn on top of each other ahead: one car not merged (conservative, but a visible duplicate).

findings.problem: U3 / U4 duplicate of one car

findings.problem: overlapping single-observer duplicates of a far car

S20/run_0.summary: B rear-ends A, named correctly (the collision lost during development is back); a transient duplicate U5/U8 in the right lane at -1.05 s ends when B's track is lost.

findings.problem: U11 heading spin 46 deg; U9/U10/U11 overlap

S22/run_0.summary: Merge contact A-B correct, the occluded car reappears as one road user near the recorders; overlapping pair U3/U6 at lead-in and a 3.8 m box jump of U2 at +3.7 s.

S23/run_0.summary: Contact A-B after A swerves is named correctly; at long range (about 45 m, beyond the relevance envelope) U5/U6 overlap and U4/U5 touch; U2 drawn tilted and jumping 3.2 m at -6.3 s.

S24/run_0.summary: A rear-ends B between C and D: partner B named correctly, not the abreast neighbours; U3 (seen by B) and U8 (seen by A) are one car in the right lane drawn twice; A starts a CRITICAL_TTC to B 0.45 s after their own contact while they stay touching.

findings.problem: CRITICAL_TTC A->B after the own collision
